subject: Computer Science
title: Class 8 Computer Science Olympiad — Paper 1
instructions: The time allowed for this paper is 60 minutes.
This paper contains 50 objective-type (multiple-choice) questions carrying a total of 60 marks.
There is no negative marking for wrong answers.
Each question has four options; choose the one correct answer.
Section 1 and other regular sections carry 1 mark per question; the Achievers Section carries 3 marks per question.
Use of calculators is not permitted unless specified.

questions.question: Which of these does not belong: JPEG, PNG, GIF, PDF
options: PDF (a document format, others are image formats)

questions.question: A file downloads at 4 MB per second. How long will a 40 MB file take?
Find the odd one out: Monitor, Speaker, Printer, Mouse
options: Mouse (input device, others are output devices)

questions.question: If a folder has 4 subfolders each with 3 files, how many files in total?

options: Software with a free trial only

questions.question: What is a computer virus?

options: Using digital platforms to harass or intimidate someone

questions.question: Why is it important to log out of accounts on shared computers?
options: To prevent others from accessing your personal information

questions.question: What should you do if a stranger online asks for your home address?
options: Do not share it and tell a trusted adult
Share it if they seem friendly

Ignore the request but continue chatting

questions.question: What is 'phishing'?
options: A fraudulent attempt to steal sensitive information by pretending to be trustworthy
A method to speed up internet connection

questions.question: A user receives a message claiming they won a prize and must click a link and enter their bank details to claim it. Analyze the red flags in this message.
options: This is a normal and safe way to claim online prizes
Unsolicited prize claims requiring financial details are classic phishing signs

questions.question: A computer runs slowly, shows unusual pop-ups, and unfamiliar programs appear. What is the most likely cause and best first response?

questions.question: A student is building a simple webpage and wants text to appear as a clickable link to another page. Which HTML tag and attribute should be used?

questions.question: A student in Scratch wants a sprite to move forward 10 steps and repeat this 5 times. Which programming concept should be used?

questions.question: A school network allows all computers to connect to one central switch. If the switch fails, what happens to the network, and what type of topology is this?
